summary: Phase 3 Feinschliff frontend verification: responsive overflow audit at 390/768/1024, page-reveal animation visibility, user-selectable motion preference (auto/off/on) with persistence, and reduced-motion effect on EnergyFlow. All 5 requested test cases PASS. No console errors or page errors on any route.

issues: Top nav items overflow horizontally past 1024px (last item nav-integrations at right≈1158). Nav is clipped (document.scrollWidth==winW so no page overflow), but the last link may be partially cut off / out of view on small-desktop screens. Suggest a compact nav variant or horizontal scroll indicator at <=1024px.
Nav items extend beyond viewport (clipped by overflow). Users on 390px cannot reach nav-diagnose/nav-integrations unless container is horizontally scrollable. Consider a hamburger menu for <768px.

Recharts warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — small ResponsiveContainer children momentarily render with no size. Cosmetic console noise; functional charts still display. Add minWidth:0 to grid children or explicit width.

action_items: (Optional, UX) Add mobile hamburger menu or horizontal-scroll nav for widths <= 1024px to prevent nav-integrations/nav-diagnose from being clipped.
(Cosmetic) Silence Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings by adding minWidth:0 on flex/grid chart containers.
critical_code_review_comments: MotionProvider correctly persists 'solar.motionPref' in localStorage and toggles html classes 'reduce-motion' (effective) and 'motion-force-on' (pref==='off'). Clean 3-state logic.
EnergyFlow correctly gates <animateMotion> photons and the 'flow-particles' CSS class behind useMotion().reduced — verified 10 animateMotion → 0 in reduced mode, 4 flow-particles → 0 in reduced mode.
.page-reveal keyframes resolve to opacity:1 after load (no fill-mode starvation observed on Dashboard — all 3 critical sections at opacity 1).
Nav clipping at 1024/390 is the only responsive concern; no horizontal document overflow anywhere (scrollWidth==innerWidth on all 6 routes × 3 viewports).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 polish verified. Motion preference tri-state (auto/off/on) works, persists across reloads, and correctly affects EnergyFlow photons + flow-particles. Page-reveal staggered animation does NOT hide content. No horizontal page overflow at 390/768/1024 (document.scrollWidth == innerWidth on /, /verlauf, /steuerung, /geraete, /diagnose, /integrationen). The only reported items are UX suggestions (collapse nav for narrow viewports) — not required by this task. Note: SunTimeline markers are testid 'sun-marker-day' and 'sun-marker-night' (not 'sun-marker'/'moon-marker') — spec allowed either, present as expected.
